description.en: Noctarines are shadow plants that explode and create clouds of damaging and slowing gas.
description.zh: 暗影油桃属于暗影植物，在种植时制造能够减速并且造成伤害的毒气。

chat.en: For a plant churning with internal gases, Noctarine's opinions are shockingly conventional. "Jaws is a good movie, " he says. Like, NO KIDDING, Noctarine!
chat.zh: 作为一株体内翻腾着气体的植物，暗影油桃的见解却出奇地循规蹈矩。“《大白鲨》是部好电影，”他说。拜托，我认真的，我可是暗影油桃！

text.en: Noctarine gas can power shadow plants
text.zh: 油桃的毒气能使暗影植物充能
充能的油桃能使僵尸减速
